title: Contextual Admin Helpers and Step Templates
creator: Avery Chen
description: Introduce a lightweight "contextual admin helpers" library plus a parametrized Step Template Runner that turns existing runbooks into reusable, audited, and RBAC-aware step templates callable from the ops console and CLI. Goal is to reduce the mean time to resolve (MTTR) for common support flows, enforce safe defaults (dry-run, confirmation prompts, rate limits), and emit structured telemetry for post-incident analysis. Work includes runtime library, template registry, secure secrets access hooks (KMS), and a compact web UI widget for triggering and viewing step progress.
acceptance_criteria: Core helpers library published as an internal package (versioned) and adopted by at least two existing runbooks
Step Template Runner implements idempotency keys and a dry-run mode; dry-run can be toggled via flag and appears in audit logs
All actions executed via templates are logged with structured telemetry (route, template_id, user, start/end timestamps, success/failure) and appear in Console traces
RBAC checks consult the central identity service and prevent privileged steps unless caller has admin role; unauthorized attempts return 403 and are audited
Secrets access uses the approved KMS integration and rotates ephemeral tokens per-run; no plaintext secrets in logs
End-to-end integration test that simulates a common support flow (rotate-ephemeral-credentials) passes in CI and on a staging Dedicated cluster
tasks: Design API for helpers library and Step Template manifest (param schema, outputs, rollback hints)
Prototype runtime hooking into existing runbook executor and CLI runner
Implement KMS token exchange and ephemeral secrets adapter
Add RBAC gate and mapping to identity roles
Client-side widget for Console: trigger modal, live logs, cancel button
Telemetry schema and Console ingestion mapping
Write integration tests and staging runbook conversion for 'restart stalled worker' flow
Documentation: developer quickstart, ops runbook migration guide, change log
